main_text.l: pacem folidam ecclefiæ & regni ftabiliendam ex-
cogitari potuerunt, 2. Quia non deftiterunt arces
regias ufque adeo follicitè cuftodire ut nihil appa-
ratus bellici, aut alterius cujuflibet neceffarii, inferri
permittant. 3. Quia illicitos conventus cogant, ac
novum tribunal Edenburgi erexerint, in manife-
stum summæ authoritatis ac legum contemptum.4.
Quod ex deputatis fuere quidam in Hibernia, &
Scotia censuris ecclefiafticis notati, alii à minifterii
functione legitimè suspensi, alii ad minifterium il-
legitimè promoti, omnes denique juramento con-
stricti ad regiminis Episcopalis subversionem.
5. Quia liberæ delegandorum ad synodum electioni
præscripserunt; privatim ubique monentes & ju-
bentes, ut prætermissis iis qui animitus non fav-
è[?]rent omnibus ipsorum consiliis ii soli deputarentur;
de quorum zelo constaret. 6. Quia Glasguam ad-
venerunt locum Synodo præstitutum armis lege v-
etitis accincti, ac comitatu frequentissimo, nulla ha-
bita edicti illa speciali[?]ter vetantis ratione. 7. Quia
peremptorie abnuerint sex assessoribus à rege des-
ignatis, jus suffragii definitivi. 8. Quia obstinatè
renuebant ne Episcoporum protestatio prælege-
retur, ante præsidis electionem & literarum fidei
examinationem. 9. Quod regia declaratione re-
gistris Synodicis ad perpetuam memoriam inserta,
non contenti, eo collimarent omnia ipsorum consilia,
ut Episcopatum ipsum penitùs everterent, adeoque
tertium ordinum regni membrum amputarent: &
fundamentales regni leges refigerent: Quæ cum
manifestum Monarchici regiminis damnum secum
trahant, ejusmodi conventui non potuisse Deputa-
tum Marchionem diutius interesse; ideoque inde
discessisse, 28. Novemb. quando licet anxiè rogi-
tasset, ut actionem illam precibus clauderent, pol-
licitus, se die crastino rediturum ut responsurum ec-
rundem

page.notes: Uncertain readings: "favèrent" (the letter after "fav" is blurred and may be a ligature or accent) and "speciali[?]ter" (the joining of the word is unclear). The left margin strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and is omitted. The small mark below the text is not a clear gathering signature and is omitted. The printed long s is rendered as a plain s throughout; where the scan shows an s-like form, the text has been given as printed. The word "Glafguam" is printed as such. The final word of the page is "ec-rundem" (the word continues over the line end, "eorundem" as the sense requires, but only "ec-" and "rundem" are printed here).
